whatsapp.title: WhatsApp connection
whatsapp.subtitle: Connect the hotel's WhatsApp number to StayLine
whatsapp.sdk_failed: The Meta connection window could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.
whatsapp.no_phone_selected: No phone number was selected in the connection window. Try again and complete the number step.
whatsapp.cancelled: The connection was abandoned (step: {step}). You can try again.
whatsapp.cancelled_generic: The connection window was closed. You can try again.
whatsapp.no_session_info: Meta did not send the account details. The platform admin should check the allowed domains in the Meta settings.
whatsapp.not_configured_desc: NEXT_PUBLIC_META_APP_ID and NEXT_PUBLIC_META_ESU_CONFIG_ID are not set in the panel. Tell the platform admin.
whatsapp.popup_open: The Meta window is open. Complete the steps there.
whatsapp.disconnect_confirm: If you disconnect, guest messages will not reach StayLine. The number stays registered at Meta and you can reconnect any time. Continue?
whatsapp.before_1: The number must not be registered in the WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business app.
whatsapp.before_2: The window must be opened by someone with full control of the hotel's Meta business account.
whatsapp.before_3: The display name must match the hotel's real name and website; Meta reviews it.
whatsapp.before_4: After connecting, add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager; otherwise messages cannot be sent.
whatsapp.migrate_launch: Move my number from another provider
whatsapp.migrate_hint: Choose this if your number is currently used on the WhatsApp Business API through another company. The window only creates the WhatsApp account; you move the number here afterwards.
whatsapp.migrate_cancel_confirm: The move will be cancelled and the account connection removed. Your number keeps working with the old provider. Continue?
whatsapp.migrate_req_1: Ask your current provider to turn off two-step verification for this number.
whatsapp.migrate_req_2: Keep the phone that receives SMS or calls for this number at hand; the verification code is sent there.
whatsapp.migrate_req_3: The number keeps working with the old provider until the last verification step.
whatsapp.migrate_final_note: The moment you verify, the number moves from the old provider to StayLine and guest messages start arriving here.
